t: prairie star | Pipilo Native Plants
s: The earliest bloomers appear on well-drained south facing slopes, but this species (also known as woodland star) can tolerate a pretty wide variety of growing sites. This species is ephemeral, meaning it goes completely dormant (and invisible) during the summer. They aren't dead, however, and will return with force the following spring. I suggest marking where you plant them so you don't accidentally disturb their sleep. Although small, prairie stars reseed readily and create a little colony if conditions allow.
